findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-3 AC: on the page opened by Book again, a reason for visit of exactly 300 characters is accepted and the booking succeeds.
findings.text: Still open from attempt 1 (F-2). S-3 AC5 tests only the rejecting side of the 300-character limit. No AC checks that exactly 300 characters is accepted, so a limit tightened by one character would still pass.

findings.text: Still open from attempt 1 (F-4). The phrase 'the local side of midnight' in S-2 AC2 is unclear. The UTC conversion written into the AC already makes the point.

rubric_items.reason: At least one story traces each of the 19 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-19). The intent has no assumed REQs.
Most stories have one outcome each. S-3 combines prefill, editing and the limit. S-5 combines the booking rules, the new ID and the untouched original. Both are still small.

The ACs use Given/When/Then and mostly tell right from wrong. The time-zone AC uses an instant whose local and UTC dates differ. APT-2 is now covered by S-5 AC5. Gaps: the 300-char limit is tested on one side only, and S-6 AC3 ends 'behaves as today'.
Every value comes from the intent: 300 characters, Asia/Kolkata, the button texts and the APT rule ids. The UTC+05:30 instant is worked out inline in the AC.
The terms are clear and match the glossary. S-2 AC2 still has the awkward phrase 'the local side of midnight'.
